findings.title: A draft in another visible TagRow remains unprotected and clicking the material commits it
findings.cause: App.materialReadBlocked does not know local editing state of other TagRow instances. editing!==null only disables material inside the same mb.myth TagRow.
reproduction: Import the valid fictional Sea-v9 fixture and select central myth A.
Add/display region mb.land via existing Земля +; enter edit mode and edit the first region land text.
Fill UNCOMMITTED OTHER TAG DRAFT, leave the input focused.
Observe the myth material toggle remains enabled; use page.mouse.click at its actual bounding-box center.
findings.expected: All new material controls disabled; active input retains focus and draft; accepted document/history unchanged.
findings.actual: Toggle enabled=true while input focused=true. Pointer click triggers onBlur commit; textbox count becomes0, document differs from pre-draft exported JSON, activeElement becomes BODY.
findings.required_change: Expose current text-draft state from every visible TagRow to the narrow material-read guard; preserve existing generic editor commit/Enter/Escape contract. Add an actual cross-row pointer/blur regression.

findings.title: Removing the focused material view leaves focus on BODY
findings.cause: The keyed view unmount invalidates requests but has no focused-subtree fallback to the existing information container.
reproduction: Open A material and focus an omen summary.
Invoke actual App selection handler for B, removing A material.
Separately focus A summary then import a valid accepted map changing A from myth to dwelling.
findings.expected: When the target/view disappears, focus moves to the existing information heading/container; no jump to BODY or old detached content.
findings.actual: Both independent DOM probes observed document.activeElement.tagName === BODY and information-container focus=false.
findings.required_change: Restore focus for a removed focused disclosure subtree, respecting already-selected live external targets; add regression for target loss.
